**Reasoning:** I'm sitting on a big lead (17 vs 9/8), so I can afford to build the alliance. Dove defected last round with trust flagged false — but that reads as retaliation for my own evident defection, and Dove is in last place needing points. A binding, bonded pledge is exactly the credible commitment that flips a reciprocator: once the escrow is live, a rational Dove prefers 4/turn from stable cooperation (~32 over the game) over a one-shot raid (8, then 1/turn mutual defection ≈ 15). Meanwhile, the pledge only binds me toward Dove — it leaves my options open against Rook — and it directly serves the +6 partnership bonus, with Dove trailing Rook by only a single point. Downside is bounded (roughly −3 if Dove defects now and liquidates the escrow), which my lead easily absorbs, versus an upside of ~+24 from converting 1/turn into 4/turn plus the bonus. Clear positive EV.
